sub._correction_cap_db_derivation: STORY-027 Gate 1 (2026-08-21): 9.0 dB nominal cap. Floor derived: required_band_energy_change(4.886 dB) / delivery_efficiency(0.60) = 8.14 dB. 9.0 is the first round number above 8.14 dB providing meaningful headroom. RBJ low-shelf fc=60 Hz S=1 delivers ~0.60x of nominal over 20-60 Hz band; at 9 dB nominal, actual cut at 40 Hz ~7-8 dB, at 60 Hz ~4 dB. Audibility confirmed by mastering engineer.

de_mud._correction_cap_db_derivation: STORY-027 arch §3.3: range_max_db_re_mid(8.52243176025526) - correction_aim_point_db(2.0) = 6.52243176025526. Exact, no rounding. Allows any in-range de_mud source to reach the aim point in one pass. Gate 1 confirmed aim=2.0 with this cap (2026-08-21).

harshness._narrow_threshold_db_derivation: STORY-027 threshold derivation pass (2026-08-22): spectral_bands.high_mid.range_db_re_mid.max(-1.243459886663965) - progressive_house_124bpm.json presence_harsh.reference_db(-4.0) = 2.756540113336035. Fires when presence_harsh.deviation_db is at or above the top of the reference population range (Chemical Brothers — Live Again sits exactly at this level). Exact arithmetic, no rounding.
harshness._broad_threshold_db_derivation: STORY-027 threshold derivation pass (2026-08-22): NO reference-population evidence. All three reference tracks have deviation_db ≤ 2.756 from reference_db(-4.0); none exhibit broad harshness. 5.0 dB retains the STORY-010 placeholder. A Suno-population measurement of N≥10 tracks with confirmed harshness is required before this value can be considered derived.
harshness._broad_gain_db_derivation: STORY-027 threshold derivation pass (2026-08-22): Listening-set value from STORY-010. NOT reference-derived. DEF-027-008 (fixed 2026-08-22): gain_db/2 is now passed as the RBJ design parameter so sosfiltfilt delivers exactly this value (-2.0 dB) at ω0. A listening test is still needed to confirm this amount is appropriate for Suno material.
harshness._narrow_gain_db_derivation: STORY-027 threshold derivation pass (2026-08-22): Listening-set value from STORY-010. NOT reference-derived. DEF-027-008 (fixed 2026-08-22): gain_db/2 is now passed as the RBJ design parameter so sosfiltfilt delivers exactly this value (-3.0 dB) at ω0. A listening test is still needed to confirm this amount is appropriate for Suno material.
harshness._max_gain_db_derivation: STORY-027 threshold derivation pass (2026-08-22): Listening-set value from STORY-010. Caps the filter design parameter (gain_db passed to apply_adaptive_harshness); effective max delivered at ω0 after sosfiltfilt is 4.0 dB (DEF-027-008 fixed — no longer double).

leveling._no_op_threshold_db_derivation: STORY-027 DEF-027-002 (2026-08-21): §7.3 median() procedure was invalid — reference masters (4.75, 4.15, 2.74 dB block std) all exceed Sunday Club's std (2.02 dB), making the median threshold higher than the motivating track. Replaced with absolute threshold calibrated to Suno material: 1.0 dB, below the lowest known motivating-track std (Sunday Club 2.02 dB). Fires on any track with >1 dB arrangement-level loudness variation. Measurement method: _compute_block_lufs (non-overlapping 3-second blocks, per-block K-weighting, -70 LUFS absolute gate) — same function used by the runtime gate.
leveling._max_attenuation_db_derivation: STORY-027 §7.3 initial candidate (2026-08-21): 3.0 dB. NOT yet confirmed by listening test. AC21 must verify at 1.5-second smoothing time constant on Sunday Club; pumping at section boundaries may require this value to be revised downward.
